answer: Non-refundable attestation fees and compounding opportunity costs create superadditive marginal expenses per Sybil identity, forming an escalating cost curve that raises entry thresholds. A whisper triggers a slashing ripple, isolating the adversarial haven and deterring Sybil proliferation via endogenous capital externalities.
